Total hours available on the weekend = 7 + 5 = 12 hours.
Time spent reading = 3 hours.
Remaining time = 12 - 3 = 9 hours.
Time spent playing video games = 1/3 of 9 hours = 3 hours.
Time spent playing soccer = 9 - 3 = 6 hours.

Percentage of the weekend spent playing soccer = (6 / 12) * 100% = 50%.

ANSWER: 50
